components.title: Versioned contracts
components.intent: Generate compatible Dart and TypeScript boundaries from the checked-in schemas; reject invalid wire data before business logic.
components.invariant: schemaVersion is 1; unknown command types fail closed; additive event fields may be ignored. No answer key appears in public projection.
components.data: packages/contracts/schema; generated Dart/TS bindings; golden fixtures

components.title: Flutter application shell
components.intent: Provide mobile navigation, dependency injection, common stage chrome and accessible view states for independently owned features.
components.invariant: Views render repository state and issue intents; they never calculate competitive scores or own provider credentials.
components.data: In-memory view models; bounded local preferences; no answer cache

components.title: Identity and session access
components.intent: Use Firebase anonymous sign-in for the first playable private-room pilot, with explicit optional account upgrade.
components.invariant: User identity comes from a verified Firebase token, never a uid in request payload; account deletion revokes access.
components.data: Firebase Auth users; user-private consent version; session capabilities

components.title: Player profiles and preferences
components.intent: Collect minimal nicknames, avatar presets, language and era preferences used to build a fair shared room pack.
components.invariant: Public profile contains no email or consent detail; preference intersection cannot silently exclude a player.
components.data: profiles/{uid}; userPrivate/{uid}; immutable room preference snapshot

components.title: Private room service
components.intent: Create private 1v1/2v2 rooms with transactional membership, short-lived invitations and an explicit lifecycle.
components.invariant: At most four members; authenticated membership is required for every room read; invite code is not sufficient for answer access.
components.data: rooms/{roomId}; roomCodes/{digest}; rooms/{roomId}/members/{uid}

components.title: Lobby, team selection and readiness
components.intent: Make team membership and device readiness explicit before server-authorized match start.
components.invariant: Teams balance exactly for the selected mode; every present player acknowledges the same settings version.
components.data: members teamId/slot/readyVersion; readiness report; turn rotation schedule

components.title: Invitations and app links
components.intent: Support room code, QR and HTTPS app links with a browser fallback and explicit code entry after installation.
components.invariant: Firebase Dynamic Links is excluded; no invite grants membership without authenticated join and capacity checks.
components.data: Hashed invite token; expiresAt; revocation version; local pending invite

components.title: Presence and reconnection
components.intent: Combine RTDB disconnect signals with application heartbeats and authoritative match resumption.
components.invariant: Presence is advisory; losing RTDB connectivity alone never changes a score. Rejoining uses latest server version.
components.data: RTDB connections/{uid}/{connectionId}; Firestore presence projection; reconnect token

components.title: Authoritative match engine
components.intent: Execute a versioned state machine, deterministic round plugins and durable phase transitions.
components.invariant: Only the server advances phase. Firestore transaction bodies perform no network I/O; side effects use an idempotent outbox.
components.data: matches/{id}; privateMatchState/{id}; commands/{commandId}; events/{seq}; outbox/{id}

components.title: Scoring, steals and disputes
components.intent: Convert verified evidence into a deterministic ledger with equal opportunities and explicit private-party dispute handling.
components.invariant: The model never supplies final points. Every ledger entry has a unique source attempt or reversal and a reason code.
components.data: scoreLedger/{entryId}; per-round opportunity counters; review requests

components.title: Mobile audio capture
components.intent: Capture short consented singing attempts with one mobile microphone, explicit controls and predictable PCM framing.
components.invariant: 24kHz mono signed16 little-endian; max20 seconds; stop immediately on grant revocation or background. Never record before consent.
components.data: Transient PCM buffer; attempt grant; bounded local retry recording

components.title: Realtime audio relay
components.intent: Run an authenticated Cloud Run WebSocket gateway with Redis room fan-out, one active singer and a server-only Muse stream.
components.invariant: Cloud Run affinity is not a correctness mechanism. Room authorization and active attempt are rechecked; never put PCM in Firestore.
components.data: Single-use relay tickets; Redis room channels; transient attempt buffers; connection generations

components.title: Cue media playback
components.intent: Preload authorized opaque cue assets and coordinate audio/video/still playback with the match cue barrier.
components.invariant: No future answer metadata or stable public download URLs; a cue becomes playable only to authorized current-match members.
components.data: Opaque asset IDs; short-lived URLs; bounded local cache; playable acknowledgements

components.title: Meta Muse gateway
components.intent: Own Meta request construction, credentials, model policies, deadlines, structured responses and metered usage.
components.invariant: Use Standard IDs only. Voice Transcribe has no confidence scores or TTS; Spark1.3 audio is excluded until documented/evaluated.
components.data: Secret Manager key; model policy; provider requestId; redacted usage ledger

components.title: Answer adjudication
components.intent: Fuse bounded transcript evidence, curated aliases and song-section rules into auditable accept/reject/abstain outcomes.
components.invariant: Speech capability does not prove singing accuracy; acceptance uses calibrated evaluation thresholds, never invented ASR confidence.
components.data: Song aliases; phonetic forms; section alignments; immutable evidence and decision version

components.title: Song catalogue and rights
components.intent: Maintain versioned song identities, accepted sections, opaque clues and publication rights needed by all ten round plugins.
components.invariant: Client catalogue never includes answer keys or licensed lyric bodies before reveal; withdrawn rights block new scheduling.
components.data: songs/private variants; public pack summaries; clue assets; rights records; versioned manifests

components.title: AI host and stage presentation
components.intent: Deliver concise Hindi/Hinglish hosting around verified events while keeping the competitive path usable without generation.
components.invariant: Host text cannot mutate game state; fallback lines and device/prerecorded speech are always available. Muse is not a TTS service.
components.data: Versioned line templates; optional Spark text; client speech settings; no celebrity voice clone

components.title: Results and rematches
components.intent: Close the game with a trustworthy score breakdown and a low-friction private rematch.
components.invariant: Results derive from the immutable ledger; an abandoned match is distinct from a win, draw or provisional party result.
components.data: matchResults/{id}; round summaries; rematch votes; consented local history

components.title: Safety, privacy and access policies
components.intent: Enforce participant access, minimal recording retention, reporting and consistent handling of personal data.
components.invariant: Private rooms are not public broadcasts; explicit audio processing consent is required, raw attempts are not analytics payloads.
components.data: Consent records; scoped moderation reports; deletion jobs; security rule test fixtures

components.title: Content operations console
components.intent: Provide an internal Flutter web or CLI-assisted editor for licensed song metadata, cue QA and reversible pack publication.
components.invariant: Admin roles are server verified. AI suggestions remain draft and cannot publish content or rights claims.
components.data: Draft content records; editor approvals; validation reports; publication history

components.title: Observability, analytics and costs
components.intent: Measure product completion, realtime latency, AI outcomes and spend while keeping user content out of logs.
components.invariant: Metrics are structured and bounded; performance targets remain unmeasured until physical-device and load evidence exists.
components.data: Redacted structured logs; analytics event registry; cost aggregates; release dashboards

components.title: Build, Firebase infrastructure and release
components.intent: Make emulator development, isolated environments, CI, controlled deployment and evidence-based release reproducible.
components.invariant: Planning does not provision billing resources. No production deploy until secrets, rights, security and device gates are evidenced.
components.data: Version locks; infrastructure manifests; CI definitions; release evidence; environment templates

components.title: Classic Antakshari
components.intent: Choose an unused song whose canonical opening sound matches the displayed Hindi sound token.
components.invariant: Compose the common engine and scoring ports; never add another round-specific match state machine.
components.operations: prepare; projectCue; getPrivateView; evaluateEvidence; reveal; summarize
components.data: first/final sound index, canonical song IDs, accepted opening phrases

components.title: Dhun Pehchano
components.intent: Play the curated instrumental intro, then accept song identification and a sung opening separately.
components.invariant: Compose the common engine and scoring ports; never add another round-specific match state machine.
components.operations: prepare; projectCue; getPrivateView; evaluateEvidence; reveal; summarize
components.data: instrumental intro interval, canonical target, accepted title aliases and mukhda spans

components.title: Antara Se Mukhda
components.intent: Play an accepted antara cue and require the matching song opening/refrain.
components.invariant: Compose the common engine and scoring ports; never add another round-specific match state machine.
components.operations: prepare; projectCue; getPrivateView; evaluateEvidence; reveal; summarize
components.data: antara cue boundaries, target song variant and accepted mukhda spans

components.title: Mukhda Se Antara
components.intent: Play the opening/refrain and accept an eligible antara from that pinned song version.
components.invariant: Compose the common engine and scoring ports; never add another round-specific match state machine.
components.operations: prepare; projectCue; getPrivateView; evaluateEvidence; reveal; summarize
components.data: mukhda cue, indexed antaras and accepted version relationships

components.title: Agla Bol
components.intent: Stop the licensed cue at an annotated phrase boundary and require the next accepted phrase.
components.invariant: Compose the common engine and scoring ports; never add another round-specific match state machine.
components.operations: prepare; projectCue; getPrivateView; evaluateEvidence; reveal; summarize
components.data: phrase adjacency graph, stop boundary and accepted next-phrase alternatives

components.title: Shabd Se Geet
components.intent: Display a curated word and accept a sung phrase containing that exact approved lexical form.
components.invariant: Compose the common engine and scoring ports; never add another round-specific match state machine.
components.operations: prepare; projectCue; getPrivateView; evaluateEvidence; reveal; summarize
components.data: word/phrase occurrence index, token forms and canonical song identity

components.title: Hum & Guess
components.intent: Give only the designated hummer a target; let the teammate identify it after bounded humming.
components.invariant: Compose the common engine and scoring ports; never add another round-specific match state machine.
components.operations: prepare; projectCue; getPrivateView; evaluateEvidence; reveal; summarize
components.data: private song card, performer/guesser roles and accepted title alternatives

components.title: Do Gaane Ek Clue
components.intent: Play two approved sequential song fragments and score the two component answers independently.
components.invariant: Compose the common engine and scoring ports; never add another round-specific match state machine.
components.operations: prepare; projectCue; getPrivateView; evaluateEvidence; reveal; summarize
components.data: two distinct targets, clip order, source variants and accepted opening spans

components.title: Silent Video
components.intent: Play a curated video with physically removed audio/subtitles and ask for the associated song.
components.invariant: Compose the common engine and scoring ports; never add another round-specific match state machine.
components.operations: prepare; projectCue; getPrivateView; evaluateEvidence; reveal; summarize
components.data: sanitized video asset, approved scene interval, target aliases and opening spans

components.title: Tasveer Se Geet
components.intent: Serve approved still-image reveal stages and ask for the linked song.
components.invariant: Compose the common engine and scoring ports; never add another round-specific match state machine.
components.operations: prepare; projectCue; getPrivateView; evaluateEvidence; reveal; summarize
components.data: masked derivatives, stage schedule, target aliases and accepted opening spans
